title: The Cooking Competition
description: Tom and Nam take part in a school cooking competition.
instructions: Read about the cooking competition. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🍳 Every year, Tom's school has a cooking competition. This year, Tom and his friend Nam decided to make a pizza together. The winner would get a golden spoon and a free cooking class.

The competition started at ten o'clock in the school kitchen. There were eight teams, and each team had one hour. Mrs Clark, the head cook, was the judge. She walked around and looked at everything carefully.

Tom and Nam made the dough first. Tom mixed flour, water and a little salt, while Nam cut the vegetables. They were working very quickly when Tom dropped the bowl of tomatoes on the floor! Luckily, they had some more.

Next to them, Lucy and Mai were making a chocolate cake. Their cake looked beautiful, but Lucy forgot to turn on the oven. Mai noticed the problem after twenty minutes. 'Don't worry,' she said, 'we can still finish if we work fast.'
While the pizzas were cooking, the kitchen smelled wonderful. Nam was washing the dishes and Tom was making a salad. A boy called Sam, who was in another team, burnt his soup and had to start again.

At eleven o'clock, Mrs Clark tried every dish. She said Sam's second soup was delicious, and she loved Lucy and Mai's cake, which was soft and sweet. When she tasted the pizza, she smiled and said, 'This is the best pizza I have ever eaten.'

Tom and Nam won the golden spoon! Everyone clapped, and Tom's mum took a photo of them. 'If we practise more, we might win again next year,' said Nam. Tom agreed, and he is going to make pizza for his family on Saturday.
